name: Brendan Wovchko
headline: CTO · Entrepreneur · Kanban Trainer
tagline: Technology leader, lifelong entrepreneur and teacher of leaders, building consumer software since the late 1990s.
bio: Brendan Wovchko is the CTO and a member of the Operating Board at Ramsey Solutions, where he leads a software organization of roughly 300 engineers, product managers, project managers and agile coaches. He has been building consumer-facing software since the late 1990s.

Before Ramsey he was a lifelong entrepreneur. He founded ArtistData, a platform that let more than 25,000 musicians publish their shows everywhere at once, and HUGE I/O, an accredited Kanban training firm. Ramsey became his biggest client, and he sold the company to join them full time.

Today he describes himself as a problem guy who knows how to leverage technology, and he talks openly about the people side of leadership: hard conversations, shared urgency, and teams that either act or argue.

venture.name: Ramsey Solutions
venture.oneLiner: Leading technology at one of America's best-known personal finance companies.
venture.description: Ramsey Solutions was founded by Dave Ramsey in 1992 and has more than 1,000 team members. Brendan joined in 2016 as Senior Technology Officer and became CTO in 2022. His teams build Ramsey's digital products, such as the EveryDollar budgeting app, and he has spoken about using voice AI to make digital experiences feel more human.

goals.title: Act or argue
goals.detail: If you agree, act. If you disagree, argue. Ignoring a decision isn't an option.

goals.title: Shared urgency
goals.detail: Most companies have a shared urgency problem: a missing commitment to courageous action.

goals.title: Hard conversations
goals.detail: A step-by-step approach to uncomfortable conversations, including the "emotional firing".

goals.title: Be a coach, not a cop
goals.detail: Coach people first, then make the decision when coaching doesn't work.
